text: You want to change the book shelf to 4 foot but with the same material and color. If it is not available, cancel the whole order and you will buy again. If the agent asks for the cancellation reason, you say you ordered by mistake.
zh: 您想将书架改为4英尺，但材质和颜色保持不变。如果不可用，取消整个订单并重新购买。如果客服询问取消原因，您说您是误下单。
